listing.name: Carter's Freetraders
listing.summary: Provides improved collision bounds and shield adjustments for this faction mod.
listing.aiSummary: Provides improved collision bounds and shield adjustments for this faction mod.

description: Offers a patch containing updated .ship files for Carter's Freetraders. These files add points to improve accuracy on rough bounds, trim others, fix asymmetrical collisions, downsize oversized bounds, adjust radii, and recenter shields.
